name: security-verification
description: Member verification with emoji captcha, web verification, pending/verified roles, and timeout sweep

configFields.label: Verification Enabled
configFields.description: Require members to verify via panel

configFields.label: Pending Role
configFields.description: Role assigned on join and removed once verified (optional)

configFields.label: Verify Timeout (minutes)
configFields.description: How long a member has to pass the captcha

configFields.label: Kick on Timeout
configFields.description: Kick members who don't verify before timeout

configFields.label: Verification Target
configFields.description: Require verification from everyone or only suspicious accounts
